display.purpose: Hero stack and footer sign-off only; Fraunces 860 SOFT 100 / WONK 1.

headline.purpose: One per section, short declarative sentence with a full stop; smaller steps for anatomy layer names, quiz result and receipt numerals.

title.purpose: Product, question and occasion names; Fraunces 600 SOFT 100 / WONK 0.

body.purpose: Running text in DM Sans; leads at 1.125 to 1.25rem, about 34ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked field labels printed on tickets, the receipt and the seal ring only.

price.purpose: All COP figures, tabular numerals, struck previous price at 70%.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Carmine buttons and active chips; hover 0 16px 28px -14px rgb(118 12 32 / 0.85).

shadows.name: object-on-counter
shadows.purpose: Photo frames, receipt, striped card (up to 0 40px 80px -40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8) on dark drenches).

shadows.name: small-object
shadows.purpose: Result rows, duo card; header when scrolled uses 0 8px 24px -18px rgb(42 23 18 / 0.6).

shadows.name: grain
shadows.value: fractal-noise SVG at 0.16 opacity, mix-blend-mode multiply
shadows.purpose: Paper surface over drenched sections and kraft plates.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default reveals (GSAP expo.out 0.9s), link underline, arrow nudge, ground colour transitions, sticky bar.

motion.name: ease-squish
motion.purpose: Button press release (0.45s), chip state, hover lifts, anatomy layers dropping in.

motion.name: spiral-draw
motion.purpose: Seal signature: 1.6s hero, 1.1s per flavor change, 1s quiz stamp, 0.55s anatomy lid.

motion.name: circular-wipe
motion.purpose: Flavor photo change; image settles from scale 1.18 / -4deg.

motion.name: ingredient-pop
motion.purpose: SVG ingredients pop in with random rotation; idle float 10px over 6s; seal ring spin 38s.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: GSAP only under no-preference; static complete states, no clip-path, float/spin off, button transitions 0.01ms, smooth scroll off.

narrative.overview:
The system is Bocatto Dolci's own packaging, laid flat on a peach counter. Every dessert is shown as it is in life: a circle of cream inside a kraft rim, closed with the round carmine sticker. Kraft paper, die-cut tickets, a toothed receipt and the striped border of the brand's personalised card are the furniture; carmine is the ink and the seal. Nothing is borrowed from a generic restaurant template: no split-hero-plus-three-cards, no grid of identical product tiles.

Density is generous and warm. Headlines are huge, heavy and soft-cornered (Fraunces at weight 860 with SOFT 100 and WONK on) so they rhyme with the hand-lettered logo, while every functional word (prices, nav, buttons, notes) is set in a plain, friendly DM Sans. Whole sections are drenched in one material (peach, kraft, carmine, cacao, or a flavor's own colour) rather than boxed into cards. A fine paper grain sits over the drenched fields.

Motion is tactile: things are served, stamped and squished. The signature is "la espiral", a single-stroke cream swirl inside the seal that pipes itself in. Under reduced motion everything is present and still.
keyCharacteristics: Peach ground, kraft fields, carmine drenches; cacao for type and chocolate chapters.
Fraunces heavy SOFT/WONK headlines against DM Sans UI.
Packaging objects as components: round seal, notched kraft ticket, toothed receipt, striped card, round kraft-rimmed thumbnails.
Soft, long, tinted drop shadows; no hard offsets, no glass.
Squish on touch, expo on reveal, a self-drawing spiral as signature.
The order is always one tap away (carmine pill button, mobile sticky bar).

rules.name: The Drench Rule
rules.body: A section changes material, not decoration: it takes one full-bleed ground (peach, peach-deep, kraft, carmine, cacao, or a flavor colour) with grain, and its ink flips to match. Never a white card floating on a coloured section.

rules.name: The Flavor Wardrobe Rule
rules.body: In the flavor explorer each cheesecake owns a ground, ink, accent and seal cream (Frutos Rojos carmine/#fff1e6, Maracuyá passion/cacao, Oreo cacao/peach, Nutella brown/peach, Milo kraft/cacao). Section background and colour transition together over 0.7s expo-out, and the focus ring follows the ink via `--focus`.

rules.name: The Orange Is a Deal Rule
rules.body: Orange marks discounts and the striped border. It does not become a second button colour or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Fraunces speaks (headlines, names, the slogan); DM Sans informs (prices, nav, buttons, notes). Never set a price or a button in Fraunces, never set a headline in DM Sans.

rules.name: The Printed Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels exist only as fields printed on a packaging object (ticket, receipt, seal ring). They never float above a section headline.

rules.name: The Counter Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows always fall straight down, long and soft, with a negative spread and a cacao or carmine tint. No hard offset shadows, no grey ambient glows, no glassmorphism.

dos: Do drench whole sections in one material (peach, peach-deep, kraft, carmine, cacao or a flavor ground) with grain, and flip the ink and `--focus` to match.
Do show product photos as circles or arches ringed in kraft, the cup seen from above.
Do express prices, conditions and steps as packaging objects: tickets, the receipt, dotted leaders.
Do keep every order action a carmine pill with an up-right arrow that opens the exact OlaClick product.
Do set headlines in Fraunces 860 with SOFT 100 / WONK 1 and functional text in DM Sans.
Do use the seal's self-drawing spiral to confirm moments (hero arrival, flavor change, quiz result), and give every animation a still, complete reduced-motion state.
Do keep the unofficial-concept strip visible above the header.
donts: Don't use orange as body text on peach; use orange-ink, or keep orange to badges and stripes.
Don't put uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headlines; printed labels belong on tickets, the receipt and the seal ring only.
Don't use hard offset shadows, grey ambient glows or glass blur; shadows fall long, soft and tinted.
Don't set prices, buttons or nav in Fraunces, or headlines in DM Sans.
Don't redraw the logo or invent a second seal; the round sticker with the spiral is the only emblem.
Don't fall back to the restaurant template (split hero, three equal cards, uniform product grid).
Don't use emoji or icon-font glyphs; icons and ingredients are inline SVG.
